findings.title: Restore the compact ticket overview when returning from events
findings.requirement: Esc returns one level and restores selection and scroll position.
findings.description: Actual Pi at 40x12 opened the child ticket overview, then Events. Esc returned to the child-list pane, not the overview. Activating the ticket ancestor did the same. Both paths force list focus; compact rendering therefore hides the saved ticket overview and scroll position. Tab is needed to recover the overview.
findings.required_change: Restore the ticket overview pane and its saved scroll position on compact Esc and ticket-ancestor return. Do not unconditionally reset those destinations to list focus.
findings.validation_scenario: Open /shared-context. Enter an initiative, then a child. Page the ticket overview. Enter Events and press Esc. The ticket overview must reappear at its saved position. Repeat through the focused ticket ancestor. Assert the canonical ticket remains unchanged.
findings.validation_status: Reproduced independently in main actual Pi: pi-005-overview-before-40x12.json, pi-005-events-40x12.json, pi-005-returned-40x12.json. Axis also exercised ticket-ancestor return.

findings.title: Do not redirect an unrelated action menu when a remembered ticket disappears
findings.requirement: Live updates preserve selection by record identity.
findings.description: Read A2 in alpha, return home, select B1 in All and open B1 actions. Removing only remembered A2 and updating membership consistently closes B1 actions and redirects to empty alpha. B1 still exists; visible status changes from tracker/tickets/B1.md to the empty collection. Main actual Pi reproduced the static axis finding.
findings.required_change: Gate removal navigation on the active logical screen and selected canonical target. Reconcile inactive remembered ticket state without closing or redirecting an unrelated queue or initiative action menu.
findings.validation_scenario: Use an external temporary store with tickets A and B. Read A from its initiative, Esc twice, press 8, select B, press a. Remove only A and update membership consistently. Wait for the watcher. B actions, queue selection, scroll position and canonical target must remain unchanged. Also cover a home initiative action menu while its remembered child disappears.
findings.validation_status: Reproduced in actual Pi v1.1.0 with real filesystem watcher. B1 action menu before and empty alpha after are recorded.
